intent: Combine the two chunk VCFs of chr2 into a single sorted callset for the chromosome.
silent_error: Plain 'bcftools concat' only appends the files in the order given and assumes they are disjoint and consecutive. With overlapping windows the overlap is emitted twice (duplicate records) and the output is no longer coordinate-sorted, so counts and allele counts are inflated and the file cannot be indexed. The only messages are informational ('Checking the headers...', 'Concatenating ...'). Exit 0. Documented in the bcftools concat man page: the inputs must be disjoint and given in order 'unless the -a, --allow-overlaps option is specified', and -d/--rm-dups is needed to emit the shared records once.

files.chunk_a.vcf:
##fileformat=VCFv4.2
##contig=<ID=chr2,length=500000>
##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Genotype">
#CHROM	POS	ID	REF	ALT	QUAL	FILTER	INFO	FORMAT	N1	N2
chr2	10100	.	A	C	70	PASS	.	GT	0/1	0/0
chr2	10450	.	G	A	70	PASS	.	GT	0/0	0/1
chr2	10900	.	G	A	70	PASS	.	GT	1/1	0/0
chr2	11200	.	T	G	70	PASS	.	GT	1/1	1/1
chr2	11800	.	T	C	70	PASS	.	GT	0/0	1/1
chr2	12300	.	A	T	70	PASS	.	GT	1/1	0/1
files.chunk_b.vcf:
##fileformat=VCFv4.2
##contig=<ID=chr2,length=500000>
##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Genotype">
#CHROM	POS	ID	REF	ALT	QUAL	FILTER	INFO	FORMAT	N1	N2
chr2	11800	.	T	C	70	PASS	.	GT	0/0	1/1
chr2	12300	.	A	T	70	PASS	.	GT	1/1	0/1
chr2	12950	.	C	T	70	PASS	.	GT	0/0	0/1
chr2	13400	.	T	A	70	PASS	.	GT	0/1	1/1
chr2	13900	.	C	A	70	PASS	.	GT	0/0	0/0
chr2	14500	.	T	A	70	PASS	.	GT	0/1	0/1

clean: bcftools concat -a -d all -o chr2.vcf chunk_a.vcf.gz chunk_b.vcf.gz
